findings.issue: If the email step is skipped AND a later step genuinely fails, status/exit become skipped_email (3) instead of failed (1), masking a real failure. In practice the email step stops the chain so low risk.
findings.fix_hint: Compute failed first: code=1 if any step not pass; else 3 if skipped.
